title: Threshold Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculate the threshold gamma-ray energy as E_gamma = m_pi c^2 (1 + m_pi/(2m_p)) = 145 MeV.

title: Proton Energy Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly determine the minimum proton energy using E_p = gamma m_p c^2 = 6.787 x 10^10 GeV.

title: Cosmic Ray Implications
description: Important Criteria: Provide a clear explanation of the implications for cosmic-ray protons based on the calculated energy threshold.

title: Invariant Mass Application
description: Important Criteria: Properly apply the invariant mass concept in the calculations for both parts (a) and (b).

title: Energy Units
description: Optional Criteria: Use correct units throughout the calculations, ensuring clarity in MeV and GeV.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid common sign mistakes in energy and momentum calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure all necessary factors, such as c^2, are included in the energy calculations.
